decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint sits squarely within the firm's pipeline fittings expertise and customer base, so the firm can read market feedback and improve it with existing welding, coating and testing knowledge.

The public waste bin is distant from the core pipeline business, but it draws on the firm's powder-coating and steel fabrication capabilities and its municipal customers, so the firm can still absorb what it learns and likely keeps it.

The waste bin with ashtray is a variant of the bin line and uses the same coating and fabrication knowledge for municipal buyers, but as a niche, distant product with uncertain results it carries a higher risk of being pruned.

Standalone outdoor ashtrays are furthest from the firm's knowledge base and its water-infrastructure customers, offer little learning back to the core, and are the most likely to be cut to refocus resources.
